summary: CLIRUN-1-3 is the cutover: retire the local_cli -> RunCommand(template) projection (semantic-capabilities.ts ~202-206) so shelling a CLI capability is no longer authorized, and ensure the structured capability_run path is the sole authorization. The pilot + guidance (1-2) are proven, so nothing is stranded. No dual-run (side effects).
gaps: Removing the projection must not leave a local_cli capability with NO authorized invocation path - the structured path (1-1/1-2) must fully cover it first.
Existing durable grants / scheduled jobs that referenced the projected RunCommand rule must resolve to the structured path, not silently lose access.
Tests that assert the local_cli RunCommand projection must be updated to the new behaviour.
resolutions: The structured capability_run path (CLIRUN-1-1) already authorizes any granted local_cli capability generically; retiring the projection removes only the shell route.
The capability grant/binding is unchanged; only its projection changes from a RunCommand rule to structured authorization - the agent uses capability_run (guidance shipped in 1-2).
semantic-capabilities.test.ts and any projection assertions are updated to the retired behaviour; no dual-run.
